name: zul_gurub
notes: DRAFT: a skeleton from the world database export of map 309 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json). The boss order is the usual clear order, the packs are the spawn clusters nearest each boss; walls, doors, stairs and events are unknown to it. Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
A wait_for on a door a lever or key opens needs timeout_s 60 (the default): a linked door can open 30 s after the use.
Raid plan: 20 players, the tank/healer/dps split is a placeholder. dungeon_run has no raid driver yet; the file is data for the raid leader.
Needs: Arlokk (14515), Hazza'rah, Renataki, Gri'lek, Wushoolay (Edge of Madness) have no spawn rows; Arlokk is called at the gong (GO_ARLOKK_GONG, GO_ARLOKK_FORCE_FIELD)
Needs: Hakkar's eggs (GO_EGG) and the Mandokir/Jin'do ghost sequence
